segments.speaker: Maya Chen
segments.text: Almost every serious injury downtown is caused by a car, so the center should be car-free.

segments.speaker: Jon Bell
segments.text: I could support a temporary weekend pilot if deliveries still get through.

segments.speaker: Jon Bell
segments.text: Remove the curb parking and those shops lose their customers.

segments.speaker: Maya Chen
segments.text: Jon wants every parking space protected forever, but public streets should serve everyone.

segments.speaker: Jon Bell
segments.text: I never supported trying this, even for a weekend.

segments.speaker: Jon Bell
segments.text: What would installing the barriers and signs cost?

segments.speaker: Maya Chen
segments.text: The important thing is that everyone deserves to feel safe downtown.
